mentions.name: Reproof
mentions.description: A writing app built around experimentation: writers can draft multiple takes on a paragraph and swap them in and out to hear how each sounds in context. It treats both Markdown and rich text as first-class citizens, supports side-by-side notes documents alongside the draft, and offers full keyboard control. It is used for daily writing by a small group and is about to launch.
mentions.problem: Existing writing apps lack support for experimenting with multiple takes of a paragraph and don't treat Markdown and rich text as equally capable formats.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've always wanted a writing app built around experimentation, where you could write multiple takes on a paragraph then swap them in and out to see how each sounds in context. That, and I wanted a writing app that treated both Markdown and Rich Text as first class citizens, with side-by-side documents for notes alongside a draft, full keyboard control, and more.

And so I built it: https://reproof.app/
